native_result.query: Between 3400 BCE to 3000 BCE, how does the number of monuments and axes changes with elements of symbolic capital?
native_result.HypoA: Between 3400 BCE to 3000 BCE, the number of monuments and axes increases along with symbolic capital
native_result.HypoB: Between 3400 and 3000 BCE, monument counts and axes–celts moved opposite to the only dynamic element of symbolic capital, house size: as large-house display weakened (HouseSize Z falls from +2.05 at 3400 BCE to ≈0 by 3100–3000 BCE), monument counts and axes–celts rose to a pronounced joint peak at 3200 BCE (Z +0.91 and +2.60) before partially receding by 3000 BCE. The aggregate symbolic-capital index (mean of hatchets–swords, daggers, house size) declines steadily (≈ −0.15 Z/century) and co-moves negatively with monument counts (Pearson r = −0.35, Spearman ρ = −0.41) and axes–celts (r = −0.17, ρ = −0.37), consistent with a shift of symbolic investment from competitive household display toward communal monuments and standardized tools. Daggers are exactly constant and hatchets–swords near-constant in the window, so the inverse signal is carried almost entirely by house size. Landscape openness from pollen (Belau/Woserin) declines in step with the symbolic-capital index (r = +0.88) — context only, not a causal claim.
native_result.WorkflowB: Loaded and validated all three files; verified capital.csv is the exact 100-year-binned version of time_series_data.csv raw points (CE = −BCE, 12/12 Z pairs match to 0.0). Used the 5 inclusive bins 3400–3000 BCE (all MN) from capital.csv as master source. Symbolic capital = bin-wise mean of ZAxtSchwert, ZDolch, Zhausgr (CopperGold/Amber excluded per definition); outcomes ZMonument and ZBeil; pollen context = bin-wise mean of SMOOTH_MEAN_100y. Reported forward-in-time slopes (per century), Pearson and Spearman correlations (n=5, descriptive only, no significance language), and per-component breakdown exposing the near-zero variance of Dagger/HatchetSword. Cross-checked aggregates against time_series_data.csv (0.0 max diff). Artifacts: outputs/analysis_3400_3000BCE.py (executed), outputs/analysis_output.txt, outputs/window_bins_3400_3000BCE.csv.
